criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db among AWGs reporting n_arms and n_channels
rationale: LIGENTEC AN800 MPW, 800 nm Si3N4: 6 x 6 AWG, 200 GHz (1.6 nm), 25 arrayed waveguides (2 um wide, 3.5 um pitch), FPR 111.75 um, order 112; peak on-chip losses 1.14 to 2.75 dB from centre input 3 to the six outputs, normalized to a reference waveguide; adjacent crosstalk -23.7 to -30.4 dB. Same chip 8 x 8 router (AWG1): 1.26 dB central channel. Th2A.9 (0.98 dB) reports no arm count

criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db among AWGs reporting n_arms and n_channels
rationale: imec passive SOI platform (220 nm Si on 2 um oxide, 193 nm lithography, 1 nm mask grid): 8 x 400 GHz AWG, 40 arrayed waveguides, 490 x 307 um2; insertion loss 1.3 dB (highest-power channel) to 2.7 dB (lowest), crosstalk -26 dB (Table I). Second platform (soi). The paper attributes IL differences between the 1 nm and 5 nm grid copies (5 nm copy: 2.3 to 3.7 dB) to normalization and wafer variation

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW AWG with measured insertion loss
rationale: CUMEC 16 x 16 Si AWG, 0.98 dB central-channel IL, adjacent crosstalk > 22.7 dB, 2 um arrayed waveguides, 550 x 590 um2; number of arms not reported (template drawn schematically)

criterion: foundry AWG with measured insertion loss closest to the median of measured AWG insertion loss (2.1 dB, n = 28 wdm.awg components, bound-only values excluded), reporting n_arms and n_channels
rationale: imec 248 nm DUV SOI: 16-channel 200 GHz AWG with 36 arms, 500 x 200 um; 2.2 dB insertion loss in the centre output ports (central input, normalized to a photonic wire), general crosstalk -17 to -20 dB, 3 dB centre-to-edge nonuniformity. Ties at 0.1 dB from the median with two pathak2014 copies (16 x 200 GHz 1 nm grid, 2.0 dB; 4 x 400 GHz 5 nm grid, 2.2 dB; both best-channel ends of a channel range) broken by the single centre-port value

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW directional coupler with measured performance and a drawable gap and coupling length
rationale: CSEM TFLN MPW run, gap 660 nm, coupling length 34.5 um, 600 nm wide in the coupling region, 600 nm film / 400 nm etch; measured split 12:88 (bar:cross); excess loss not reported

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW directional coupler with measured performance and a drawable gap and coupling length, second platform
rationale: imec iSiPP300 (193 nm immersion): straight symmetric 0.5:0.5 DC, gap 100 nm, coupling length 5.228 um, 380 x 220 nm strip waveguides, 5 um circular input / output bends; measured coupling ratios with cross-coupling variation 0.391 over an 80 nm span (reference design for the paper bent DC); excess loss only as model-fit values (0.07 / 0.126 dB, derived). SOI platform

criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db per_facet among edge couplers reporting tip_width_nm (tapered couplers; untapered glass / polymer butt facets excluded)
rationale: 0.52 dB per coupler TE (0.60 dB TM) at 1550 nm with a tapered lensed fiber (2.5 um spot), best polarization-independent tip of a measured tip-width sweep (Table III); 350 nm tip, 100 um linear inverse taper, 0.75 um access waveguide, 400 nm LPCVD SiN on 4.5 um thermal SiO2, 3 um PECVD SiO2 cladding; Applied Nanotools SiN rapid-prototyping process

criterion: lowest measured insertion_loss_db per_facet among edge couplers reporting tip_width_nm (tapered couplers; untapered glass / polymer butt facets excluded)
rationale: 0.56-2.21 dB per facet over 1310-2000 nm (0.56 dB at 1590 nm), SiON overlay SSC with full design table: 0.2 um LN tips, 250 / 150 / 100 um tapers, 4.4 x 4.2 um SiON overlay, 300 nm TFLN, 4.7 um BOX

criterion: foundry platform edge coupler with measured loss (D105 typical)
rationale: STMicroelectronics PIC100G SiN inverted-taper edge coupler, below 0.7 dB TE / 0.6 dB TM (taper + transition, GC-based test structures); BOX above 5 um; tip and taper length not reported

criterion: foundry PDK edge coupler with measured loss (D105 typical)
rationale: CUMEC 130 nm Si/SiN PDK SiN inverse taper, 1.6 dB per coupler (TE, 7.5 um MFD fiber); 300 nm SiN, 1 um to 350 nm taper; taper length not reported

criterion: lowest per-coupler loss from a measurement (per_coupler or loopback_half) among gc_1d components reporting period_nm
rationale: 3.5 dB per coupler (printed -3.5 dB peak fiber-to-waveguide efficiency; -5 dB before a 170 nm SiN backside AR coating), through-substrate (downward) 1D GC measured from the chip backside; period 490 nm, fill factor 0.5, 70 nm etch, 220 nm Si, 2 um BOX, 2 um oxide to a Ti/Al top reflector (reflector and thinned substrate not drawn); imec 200 mm Si photonics pilot line; first SOI hero for the template

criterion: lowest per-coupler loss from a measurement (per_coupler or loopback_half) among gc_1d components reporting period_nm
rationale: 5 dB per GC at 532 nm with period 288 nm, fill 0.6, 100 nm etch, -10 deg fiber angle, 200 nm TFLN, 2 um BOX; second platform (lnoi_rib)

criterion: foundry platform 1D GC with measured per-coupler IL (D105 typical); SOI
rationale: Samsung Foundry 300 mm SiPh platform GC, 1.9 dB per coupler, 27 nm 1-dB BW; stack 305 nm Si / 2 um BOX; period and etch depths not reported

criterion: foundry platform 1D GC with measured per-coupler IL (D105 typical); SiN
rationale: Samsung Foundry SiN GC on the same platform, 2.1 dB, 57 nm 1-dB BW; 400 nm SiN; second platform for the template

criterion: highest measured responsivity x 3-dB bandwidth among waveguide Ge PDs with a drawable top view (absorber length and width)
rationale: best device 1.19 A/W at 102.1 GHz (-2 V, paper FoM 121.5 GHz A/W); wafer mean 1.16 A/W / 101 GHz over 24 dies; Ge 600 nm x 40 um, 220 nm SOI, 3 um BOX; Ge thickness not reported (cross-section schematic for Ge); 200 mm line of the authors (fab org not named)

criterion: highest measured responsivity x 3-dB bandwidth among waveguide Ge PDs with a drawable top view (absorber length and width)
rationale: 1.01 A/W (1310 nm) and 110 GHz (-3 V); the only candidate with all required top and cross-section dimensions (Ge 550 nm x 30 um x ~300 nm on 220 nm Si, 2 um BOX); 300 mm SOI platform, fab org not stated

criterion: foundry (imec 300 mm platform) waveguide Ge PD with measured performance and a drawable top view
rationale: imec 300 mm SiPh: 0.93 A/W mean over 7 dies at 1310 nm, >110 GHz at -0.5 V, Cj 3.1 fF; Ge 300 nm x 10 um, 220 nm SOI, 2 um BOX; Ge recess depth not reported

criterion: foundry (CEA-Leti 200 mm platform) waveguide Ge PD with measured performance and a drawable top view
rationale: CEA-Leti 200 mm platform, butt-coupled lateral Si/Ge/Si PIN: >0.8 A/W at -1 V (1310 nm); intrinsic Ge 1 um x 15 um, 300 nm Si waveguide level, 0.8 um BOX; Ge thickness and bandwidth not reported. All drawable ge_pd candidates are SOI, so a second platform is not available

criterion: lowest measured p_pi_mw among thermo-optic phase shifters with a stated heater length (to-scale top view)
rationale: 0.095 mW per pi at 1550 nm (sinusoidal fit of MZI transmission vs heater power, Table 2); device 5, underetched: 10 um wide heater of length 290 um over 9 dissimilar Si passes (widths 400-650 nm, gap 0.5 um), 220 nm SOI, substrate removed under a 12 um suspended bridge; IME 248 nm lithography. MZI-level switch, one arm folded under the heater

criterion: lowest measured p_pi_mw among thermo-optic phase shifters with a stated heater length (to-scale top view)
rationale: 0.63-0.67 mW per pi at 445 nm (MZI outputs 1 and 2, first half-period, Table III; text 0.65 mW); TiN heater 983.8 um long and 10 um wide over 7 folded SiN passes (550-650 nm, 6.9 mm under the heater) on a suspended SiO2 bridge with Si undercut; AMF 200 mm visible platform; SiN about 130 nm and heater-waveguide separation about 1.86 um from XTEM of a second wafer (nominal 150 nm); second platform (sin)

criterion: median measured p_pi_mw of the phase_shifter.thermo_optic subtype (47 components with a measured P_pi)
rationale: 15.5 mW per pi (O-band, 25 C, Table 2) is the median (24th of 47) of the measured P_pi values, and a foundry device: STMicroelectronics PIC100G, TiN heater between metal 1 and metal 2, 300 nm SOI with a reconstructed BOX above 5 um; heated waveguide type and all heater dimensions not reported, so the drawing is schematic

criterion: foundry (Luxtelligence dedicated run) thermo-optic phase shifter with measured performance
rationale: Luxtelligence-fabricated TFLN: 68.4 mW at 594 nm, 78.1 mW at 640 nm; 0.75 mm TO section (heater length not reported, D111), 325 nm wide 150 nm strip, 4.7 um BOX, 1.6 um SiO2; 900 nm Au four-pass meander heater beside the arm, 250 nm above the LN top (Fig. 1(d)), lateral spacing not stated

criterion: lowest measured excess_loss_db per_component among MMIs reporting body width and length
rationale: 0.06 dB excess loss per 1x2 MMI at 1550 nm (TE) from the slope of a linear fit over a cascaded MMI tree; multimode body 3.6 x 11.5 um, access tapers 0.5 to 1.2 um; 220 nm Si on 2 um BOX, 248 nm DUV in a 0.13 um CMOS line (fab not named). Replaces valdez2022 (0.2 dB, same platform). Next SOI MMI with both body dimensions: qiao2017 0.12 dB (SMIC, dimensions read from a figure). Splitter MMIs only; crossing.mmi ranks by crossing_loss_db

criterion: lowest measured excess_loss_db per_component among MMIs reporting body width and length
rationale: 0.8 dB standalone 2x2 MMI, 4.8 x 31.4 um body, 1.2 to 2.15 um access tapers over 15 um, full TFLN rib stack; second platform (lnoi_rib); tie with li2022b (0.8 dB derived) broken by measured basis and geometry completeness

criterion: foundry MMI with measured excess loss closest to the median of measured / derived per-MMI excess loss (0.2 dB, n = 23 splitter.mmi components), reporting body width and length
rationale: A*STAR IME CMOS-compatible process: 2x2 MMI of a 16 x 16 EO switch, body 5 x 29.5 um, about 0.22 dB per MMI at 1560 nm from the linear fit of a cascaded test structure (average about 0.4 dB over 60 nm); 220 nm Si rib, 60 nm slab. Replaces kieninger2020 (IME, 0.27 dB, MMI dimensions not reported)

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW MMI with measured excess loss and both body dimensions, second platform
rationale: Applied Nanotools SiN MPW process: 1x2 MMI, body 3.9 x 10 um; excess loss 1.22 +/- 0.16 dB and imbalance 0.04 +/- 0.40 dB across the C-band against a straight SiN reference waveguide (single device, no cascade). Only non-SOI foundry MMI with both body dimensions and a measured excess loss

criterion: highest measured output_power_mw among ridge_laser-template components with a reported cavity length
rationale: >450 mW CW at 25 C (chip, 0-1000 mA), 1.8 mm cavity (Furukawa); ridge / mesa width and layer stack not reported, so the cross-section is schematic. The same 1.8 mm design in W3E.1 reports output_power_dbm only (+26 dBm), not converted

criterion: highest measured output_power_mw among ridge_laser-template components with a reported cavity length
rationale: >200 mW at 25 C (integrating sphere, L-I up to 1 A, Fig. 2(a)); InGaAsP/InP DFB, 1.75 mm cavity, HR back / AR front facets, dual-channel shallow ridge; ridge width and layer stack not reported, so the cross-section is schematic; fab org not stated; platform inp (W1B.3 material not stated)

criterion: median measured output_power_mw of the laser.dfb subtype (7 components with a measured value)
rationale: 40 mW at 150 mA, 600 um single-section DFB, the laser.dfb median (4th of 7); ties with the two-section laser of the same paper (40 mW, 2 x 300 um), broken by geometry (one total cavity length); material, ridge width and reference plane not stated

criterion: highest measured q_intrinsic among ring_bus components with a reported radius (to-scale top view)
rationale: Q_i 566 M at 1064 nm (weak coupling), > 100 M from 458 to 1550 nm; radius 750 um (1.5 mm diameter), 10 um core; ge_silica. Coupled with a U-shaped fiber taper (no bus waveguide); width only as the 3-30 um design range; reflowed, nearly circular cross-section

criterion: highest measured q_intrinsic among ring_bus components with a reported radius (to-scale top view)
rationale: Q_i 145 M (loaded Q 65 M, 30 dB extinction) at 780 nm, TM mode, from an unbalanced-MZI-calibrated resonance scan; radius 5.84 mm as printed for the two resonators of the 0.36 dB/m loss fit; Si3N4 core 40 nm x 4 um on 15 um lower SiO2, 6 um upper SiO2; bus-waveguide coupled; fabrication credited to Honeywell (acknowledgement). Second platform (sin). Gap and bus width not reported (drawn schematically). Replaces M1D.4 (sin, Q_i over 30 M). Higher measured Q_i among ring_bus components is ge_silica only (Th1D.6, Th1D.7, chen2026a)

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW ring or MRR filter with measured performance, ranked by completeness of template geometry
rationale: HyperLight wafer-scale x-cut TFLN process (248 nm DUV, 4-inch NanoLN wafer): ring radius 80 um, 2.0 um wide, 400 nm etch in 600 nm LN (200 nm slab), 4.7 um thermal SiO2, 800 nm PECVD SiO2; measured Q_i 1.8 M (0.21 dB/cm) for the lowest-loss ring near the wafer centre, identical linewidths for red and blue scans. 7 template dimensions; gap and bus not reported. LN platform; reports the template primary metric

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW ring or MRR filter with measured performance, ranked by completeness of template geometry
rationale: imec iSiPP200 SiN 2-bus MRR: radius 75 um, ring and bus width 840 nm, gap 700 nm, 400 nm core; measured FSR 314 GHz and 18.7 dB extinction; no Q reported

criterion: lowest measured transition_loss_db among transitions reporting a taper or coupler length and both layer thicknesses
rationale: 0.06 dB per coupler (as low as), 35 um taper, Si 450 to 160 nm under SiN 350 nm to 1 um, 220 nm Si / 300 nm SiN, ~180 nm gap, 3 um BOX (CUMEC PDK layers)

criterion: lowest measured transition_loss_db among transitions reporting a taper or coupler length and both layer thicknesses
rationale: 0.185 dB per coupling (TE, linear fit over cascades of 16-40 couplers against straight references) for an asymmetric vertical coupler from a 50 nm to a 150 nm Si3N4 layer, 100 um tapers; tri-layer Si3N4 / SiO2 platform (150 / 50 / 150 nm); inter-layer gap and tip widths of the measured device not stated; second platform (sin)

criterion: foundry platform Si-SiN transition with measured loss (D105 typical)
rationale: Samsung Foundry Si-to-SiN transition, below 0.1 dB TE; 305 nm Si, 400 nm SiN, 2 um BOX; taper length and tips not reported

criterion: foundry platform Si-SiN transition with measured loss (D105 typical)
rationale: STMicroelectronics PIC100G Si/SiN adiabatic transition, below 0.1 dB TE, 0.6 / 0.17 dB TM (O / C band); 300 nm Si; SiN dimension ambiguous, taper not reported

criterion: lowest measured prop_loss_db_per_cm among straight strip / rib waveguides reporting both core_thickness_nm and width_nm
rationale: 0.03 +/- 0.04 dB/cm at 532 nm (wafer-map mean, cutback on 3.7-12.9 cm spirals), 1000 nm x 110 nm ALD Al2O3 strip on 2 um thermal SiO2, 1.06 um SiO2 top cladding; authors note low confinement at 532 nm (neff 1.480); imec 200 mm pilot line; platform al2o3

criterion: lowest measured prop_loss_db_per_cm among straight strip / rib waveguides reporting both core_thickness_nm and width_nm
rationale: below 0.05 dB/cm (wavelength not stated with the value; C-band measurements) for a 2.5 um wide, about 400 nm LPCVD SiN strip with about 2.7 um under-cladding and 2.0 um top cladding; imec SiN platform; second platform (sin)

criterion: foundry PDK waveguide with measured propagation loss (D105 typical); SOI
rationale: CEA-Leti 200 mm PDK rib, median 0.1 dB/cm C band / 0.2 dB/cm O band over at least 10 dies; 300 nm Si, 160 nm slab, 2 um BOX; width not reported

criterion: foundry platform waveguide with measured propagation loss (D105 typical); SiN
rationale: Samsung Foundry SiN single-mode strip, 0.4 dB/cm O band; 400 nm SiN; width not reported

criterion: lowest measured excess_loss_db per_component among y_branch components reporting length_um
rationale: 0.28 +/- 0.02 dB cross-wafer mean excess loss (26 dies, 8-inch wafer; one die 0.27 +/- 0.01 dB) from the slope of cascaded Y-junction MZ loops; 2 um spline taper from 0.5 to 1.2 um, 500 nm waveguides, 220 nm Si, 2 um BOX, 2.3 um oxide cladding, 248 nm lithography (fab not named). Only y_branch component with a stated length and a measured excess loss; SOI

criterion: foundry / PDK / MPW Y-branch with measured performance and a stated length
rationale: Applied Nanotools EBL, 220 nm SOI on 2 um BOX: family of 11 asymmetric Y-junctions sharing splitting length 2.32 um and 500 nm waveguides; measured split ratio 0 to -18 dB across the C-band, excess loss below 0.5 dB from cascaded structures (derived). Array-level row: the per-design rows carry only the split ratio, no length; branch radii r1 0.12-1.70 um are not template dimensions
